Name: Vega shrink-wrapper component degradation
Summary: Six CSV recordings of a new and a worn cutting blade on an OCME Vega shrink-wrapper, made on the same machine to compare blade conditions in film cutting.
Description:
This Kaggle dataset from inIT-OWL has data of a new and a worn cutting blade in the Vega shrink-wrapper by OCME, a machine on food and beverage production lines that groups bottles or cans, wraps them in plastic film and heat-shrinks the film into packs. The blade cuts film fed from large spools; enclosed in a metal housing and turning fast, it cannot be inspected visually while the machine runs.

Six CSV files, three from a new blade and three from a worn one, were recorded on the same machine for comparison. The set complements One Year Industrial Component Degradation from the same machine, which follows the blade's degradation over a year instead of contrasting two blade states.

Model predictions on the worn blade show a higher average error, with error peaks when the blade meets the film. The data is cited with a CIRP CMS 2018 paper by von Birgelen and colleagues on self-organizing maps. The data was used in the IMPROVE project of the European Union's Horizon 2020 programme and is released under CC BY-SA 3.0.
